title: memory
content:
# Use memory with agents in {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} Memory helps agents reuse coding preferences and repository knowledge without asking you to repeat them in every conversation. The memory system depends on your [agent harness](/docs/agents/run/agent-harnesses.md): * **{% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} harness**: Use [{% data variables.copilot.copilot_memory %}](#copilot-memory) to store repository facts and user preferences in the cloud. * **Local harness**: Use [memory files](#local-memory-files) for persistent notes and temporary session context. For background on how memory fits into the agent architecture, see [Agents concepts](/docs/agents/concepts/agents.md#memory). This article shows how to set up cloud-backed memory, review or delete stored information, and manage local memory files.
Launch a chat prompt that asks the agent to remember a coding preference. * [Open in {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %}](vscode://GitHub.Copilot-Chat/chat?agent=agent%26prompt=Remember%20that%20I%20prefer%20arrow%20functions%20over%20function%20declarations%20in%20JavaScript.)
